notes: WhaleChat 3.71.0 — the chat lane now prefers a live stream: SSE on the app's own Node server (10–40 ms) and a hosted Pusher/Ably websocket on the Appwrite deployment (50–100 ms), with the existing poll kept as the fallback. Typing, read receipts and presence ride the same lane so one person's action shows on the other person's screen; the offline outbox and ledger are unchanged. The admin console gains an SMS & engage desk that texts a user, mirrors the message into the app chat and shows replies live.
